parameters.name: Operate
parameters.description:
The operation that you want to perform. Valid values:

*   enable: enables the automatic topic creation feature.
*   disable: disables the automatic topic creation feature.
*   updatePartition: changes the number of partitions in topics that are automatically created.

parameters.name: PartitionNum
parameters.description:
The changed number of partitions in topics that are automatically created.

This parameter takes effect only if you set Operate to updatePartition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka enable-auto-topic-creation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --operate enable --partition-num 12 --update-partition true --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka EnableAutoTopicCreation --region cn-hangzhou --PartitionNum 12 --InstanceId 'alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000' --UpdatePartition true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Operate enable
